execution_scope: QA opened all twelve original 1280x720 images independently and performed lightweight manifest/hash/source checks. QA did not execute Godot or modify product sources for this review.
post_capture_difference_scope: The contract ledger changed after capture; all hero, lighting, calibration and capture source pins still match. Captured freeze is not falsely represented as equality of every present checkout byte.

observed: Rama's chest, face, ivory drape and blue sash are more readable with a less orange portrait fill. The UI remains legible and the frozen hero silhouette is stable.
Concentric fine interference/ripple patterns are conspicuous over the after paving. Some baseline stippling is already present; this review does not assign a geometric or shader cause.
limits: The scene remains an empty horizon/floor presentation rather than the concept environment. Hair is a solid stylized mass and costume highlights remain broad/glossy.
A still does not establish shadow or interference stability during motion.

limits: Do not use this pair as evidence of equal UI draw state or a screen-regression pass. The lighting observation remains bounded to the visible hero and scene.

Puffy/stylized upper lids, neutral expression, smooth broadly highlighted skin, solid grooved hair clumps, very glossy blue sash and intense gold shoulder highlights remain visible.
The same paving interference is visible in both close-up backgrounds.
limits: This image pair does not establish fine skin texture, hair strands, richer textile roughness, blinking or animation continuity.
No new obvious boundary tear or exposed-eye gap is observed in this open-eye still; full closure relies on the separately reviewed face sequence, not these images.

observed: The day before/after difference is small at this sampled world distance. The hero retains a readable ivory/blue/gold silhouette and a similar cast shadow.
The feet retain a plausible floor relationship with no gross new floating or mesh tear visible in this frozen pose.
Large uniform paving areas and repeated simple facade/temple forms remain visually sparse and below the concept target.
limits: This is a scripted frozen observer camera with hidden UI, not a human-controlled combat encounter or validated sole contact.
No active ability, opponent or minion establishes combat readability.

observed: The after scene has a slightly cooler visible ground/sky balance. The warm lantern remains distinguishable and Rama's bow, ivory drape and cast shadow remain readable.
Fine concentric interference/ripple patterns are more conspicuous on distant paving after the change.
No new gross silhouette discontinuity or floor float is visible in this frozen pose.
limits: No continuous dusk transition, light accumulation, flicker or phase-wrap behavior is judged from these two stills.
The interference origin and its temporal stability remain unassigned.

observed: The night hero remains identifiable through the ivory drape, blue/gold costume outline, bow and cast shadow, with a warm lantern against a cool world. The before/after change is modest.
Face and dark hair are less informative at this distance; this is not a detailed night facial-readability pass.
Distant paving interference persists, and broad floor/facade shading remains simple.
limits: No active ability or reticle appears, so this does not pass night combat/VFX readability.
No new gross static contact/mesh regression is observed, but animation, sole contact and LOD switching remain separate gates.
